main.description: Begin connecting the caller to an org-configured MCP server. For an oauth server, returns the server's authorization URL, for the caller's browser to open; once they approve, the authorization server redirects back to pear, which stores the caller's tokens. For a token server, the caller's access token (for example a personal access token) is required in token; pear stores it, which connects the caller right away, and returns no URL. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

token.description: token servers only: the caller's own access token for the server, sent to it as a bearer token. Stored encrypted and never returned.

authorizationUrl.description: oauth servers only: where to send the caller's browser to authorize pear with the server. It's valid for 10 minutes and can be used once. Omitted for a token server, which is connected as soon as the call returns.
